tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /srid zhi'i mgron la gtor ma gtong tshul shin tu bsdus pa bzhugs so// oṃ swasti/ srid zhi'i mgron la gtor ma gtong tshul shin tu bsdus pa ni/ sku rim 'phral mar khri 'bum sogs grangs gsog dgos pa byung tshe gtor ma brgya rtsa rgyas pa gcig btang la de'i rjes su gtor theb bcu tshar bshams nas theb rer zan ril brgya re blugs la chu dang sbyar/ a mṛ tas bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las rin po che las grub pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du gtor ma kha dog dri ro nus pa phun sum tshogs pa ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ lan gsum/ 'byung po spyi la gtor ma sbyin pa'i sngags dang kha 'bar ma la gtor ma sbyin pa'i gzungs 'dam khar gsungs pas spyi khyab lta bu oṃ a thal mo khog stong las mdzub mo gung mo srin mdzub gsum gyi tshigs bar pa bcag pa ni nam mkha' mdzod kyi phyag rgya'i mthar se gol gtogs/ kā ro mu khaṃ sarba dharma ṇaṃ adya nutpan na twad oṃ āḥhūm̐ phaṭa swāhā/ tshar bcus bsngo/ oṃ arghaṃ nas shapta āḥhūm̐ gi bar ting shag dkrol la/ mchod sbyin gtor ma dam pa 'dis/ /'phags pa'i tshogs rnams mnyes gyur cig /dam can thugs dam bskang gyur cig /rigs drug gtor mas tshim gyur nas/ /lan chags bu lon khyer ba dang / /bla med byang chub thob par shog /ces brjod la gtor theb dang po spo/ de bzhin du bcu'i bar byas pas a kā ro brgya dang gzan ril gyi grangs stong 'gro/ de bzhin du 'bum ma song bar bsags pa ni grangs gsog byed tshul shin tu bsdus pa'i lugs/ 'phags pa rin po che dang dkon mchog lhun grub gyi gsung rab nas ji ltar 'byung tshul bzhin/ sa skya pa kun blos sbyar ba 'di'i dmigs pa lam tsam ni bshams pa'i gtor ma ri dang rgya mtsho lta bur bsams nas a kā ro brjod pa'i tshe rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang sems nyan rang chos srung nor lha rigs drug bar do gdon bgegs log 'dren thams cad kyi spyan sngar so so'i skal ba dang mthun pa'i mchod rdzas phul bas mnyes nas rang dang sbyin bdag gi sgrib sbyangs tshogs rdzogs chos srung nor lha la bskang bshags rigs drug bar do la gang la ci 'dod kyi za btung /

gdon bgegs log 'dren thams cad la sha khrag nor rdzas sogs gang la lan chags pa de 'phangs med du byung nas gnas skabs dang mthar thug gi bde ba thams cad thob par bsam mo/ /de ltar byas pas mi gcig gi zan ril stong sngags rgyas bsngos par 'gro/ mi bcu yod na sngags kyang stong 'gro/ des na cho ga 'di shin tu bsdus pas mi bcus gsog tshul gong bzhin byas na nyin gcig lnga stong tsam bsags kyang / de tsam gyi grangs gsog dka' ba mi 'byung gtor ma brgya rtsa rgyas pa dang sbrel na/ rdo rje sems dpa'i yig brgya'i gong du sbyar tshar ji ltar rigs par song rjes yig brgya man rgyun bzhin bya/ 'di rang rkyang pa byed na bdag bskyed mi dgos par thun mtshams kyi lha zhes pa/ dper na rang kyai rdor gyi bsgom bzlas byed pa zhig yin na de'i nga rgyal du gnas bzhin pas gtor ma gtong ba sogs gzhan rnams la'ang rigs 'gre yi dam gyi/ bsgom bzlas gtan mi byed pa'i mi nag phal pa lta bu zhig yin na/ bdag gis gtor ma 'di btang bas bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi sgrib sbyangs tshogs rdzogs 'phral yun gyi bde ba thob par gyur cig snyam pa'i sems bskyed bya/ yi dam gyi bsgom bzlas yod med sus nyams su len kyang thog mar/ sangs rgyas chos tshogs ma tshar gsum grangs bsags rdzogs nas/ bsod nams 'di yis thams cad gzigs pa nyid/ /thob nas nyes pa'i tshogs rnams pham byas nas/ /skye rga na 'chi'i rba klong 'khrugs pa yi/ /srid pa'i mtsho las 'gro ba sgrol par shog /dngos brgyud bla ma rnams kyi thugs rje dang / /bslu med dkon mchog gsum gyi byin rlabs dang / /chos srung dam can rgya mtsho'i nus mthu yis/ /ci bsam chos bzhin 'grub pa'i bkra shis shog/ //sarba maṅga laṃ// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 kun dga' blo gros/ srid zhi'i mgron la gtor ma gtong tshul shin tu bsdus pa/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT
